title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the immediate streets and corridors surrounding Aurora University, from student-favorite dining spots to essential neighborhood resources.

cards.title: The Main Commercial Artery
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Walk north to this major thoroughfare to find a dense cluster of local eateries, bakeries, and essential retail services just blocks from the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial corridor north of campus featuring diverse dining and retail.
cards.evidence_claim: West Galena Boulevard is described as a well-established commercial corridor with a wide range of restaurants and retail services near Aurora University.
cards.source_title: 323 W Galena Blvd, Aurora, IL 60506 - Office for Sale - LoopNet
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare accessible 24/7; business hours vary by location.

cards.title: The Community Gathering Spot
cards.subtitle: Prairie Street Corridor
cards.notes: Visit this neighborhood restaurant on Prairie Street, a known supporter of the AU community located just south of the main campus buildings.
cards.short_summary: A local restaurant on Prairie Street that serves as a community hub for students and neighbors.
cards.evidence_claim: Spartan House is located on Prairie Street and is a proud supporter of the Aurora community near the university.
cards.source_title: Top-Rated Aurora Bar & Restaurant - Spartan Ale House
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner; check official site for current kitchen hours.

cards.title: The Student Grocery Hub
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Head to this supermarket for groceries and pharmacy needs; it is the primary full-service grocery store serving the university's west side neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A full-service supermarket and pharmacy located on West Galena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Jewel-Osco is a local supermarket located at 1952 W Galena Blvd in Aurora, serving the surrounding residential and university areas.
cards.source_title: Grocery Store Near Me - Local Supermarket - Jewel-Osco in Aurora, IL
cards.access_notes: Open daily; typically 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Off-Campus Living Anchor
cards.subtitle: Gladstone Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Located just north of the main campus on Gladstone Avenue, this complex is a prominent housing option for students transitioning to off-campus life.
cards.short_summary: An apartment complex on Gladstone Avenue frequently used for off-campus student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Autumnwood Apartments is located at 734 N Gladstone Ave, within the practical orbit of the Aurora University campus.
cards.source_title: Autumnwood Apartments - 734 N Gladstone Ave Aurora, IL 60506
cards.access_notes: Private residential property; leasing office hours apply for visitors.

cards.title: Authentic Mexican Dining
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Enjoy traditional Mexican cuisine at this vibrant spot located in the West Aurora Plaza area, a short trip from the university's north edge.
cards.short_summary: A popular Mexican restaurant located on West Galena Boulevard near the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Muchacho Alegre Restaurant is located at 1941 West Galena Boulevard and specializes in authentic Mexican cuisine.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; check for daily specials.

cards.title: The Neighborhood Green Space
cards.subtitle: Prairie Street Corridor
cards.notes: Relax at this peaceful park located just north of Prairie Street, offering shaded paths and a quiet retreat for students and local residents.
cards.short_summary: A local park near the university providing green space and walking paths.
cards.evidence_claim: Welch Woods Park is located just north of Prairie Street and is described as a favorite local retreat for nature and relaxation.
cards.source_title: University Neighbors, Aurora Neighborhood: University Neighbors Neighborhood Aurora IL
cards.access_notes: Public park open from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Seasonal Local Produce
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Visit the seasonal market at West Plaza to find fresh produce and artisan goods from local vendors during the summer months.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal farmers market held at the West Aurora Plaza on Galena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: The Aurora Farmers Market at West Plaza opens seasonally and features fresh produce and artisan goodies.
cards.source_title: Farmers Market | City of Aurora, IL
cards.access_notes: Seasonal on Wednesdays from July through September; check city site for exact dates.

cards.title: 24-Hour Convenience
cards.subtitle: Prairie Street Corridor
cards.notes: Access fuel and basic convenience items 24/7 at this station located on the southern edge of the university neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour gas station and convenience store on Prairie Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mobil station at 1150 Prairie St is open 24 hours and provides fuel and convenience services.
cards.source_title: CBJS REAL ESTATE INC. - Aurora Station Details | Exxon and Mobil

cards.title: Modern Asian Cuisine
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Try fresh sushi and noodle dishes at this local favorite located in the West Plaza shopping center, popular for both dine-in and takeout.
cards.short_summary: An Asian fusion restaurant specializing in sushi and noodles on West Galena Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Sea Sushi and Noodles is located at 2009 W. Galena Blvd and is recognized for its sushi cuisine and modern interpretations of classic dishes.
cards.source_title: Big Sea Sushi & Noodles | Order Online & View Menu | Aurora IL |Sushi
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; closed on certain holidays.

cards.title: Local Panaderia
cards.subtitle: West Galena Boulevard Corridor
cards.notes: Stop by this beloved neighborhood bakery for authentic Mexican breads and pastries, a staple for residents in the University Neighbors area.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Mexican bakery located along the Galena Boulevard corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: La Chicanita Bakery is listed as a beloved neighborhood gathering place along Galena Boulevard.
cards.source_title: University Neighbors, Aurora Neighborhood: University Neighbors Neighborhood Aurora IL
cards.access_notes: Open daily; early morning hours are best for fresh selection.
